title: "Bo_HeparinSulphate"
output: html_document
date: "2026-02-08"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)
```

```{r}
tree <- treeio::read.treetime("output/treetime_withBA322/timetree.nexus")

ggtree(tree) + geom_text(aes(label = node), hjust = -0.3)
```


```{r}
tip_info <- data.frame(
  label = c("B.1", "B.1.617.2", "BA.2", "BA.2.86","BA.3","BA.3.2.2"),
  # Format in R expression syntax
  display_name = c("WT", "Delta", "BA.2", "BA.2.86","BA.3","BA.3.2.2")
)

mrsd <- read.csv("data/variants/emergence_timing_withBA322.csv") %>% dplyr::select(date) %>% pull()  %>% max()

p <- ggtree(tree, mrsd = mrsd
            ) %<+% tip_info +
  theme_tree2() +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = display_name),align = T) 
p <- p %>% rotate(7)
p
ggsave(plot=p,filename = "output/HS_lineages_withBA322.pdf",width=14,height=6)
```
